name: ML Kit (on-device)

dataTypes.when: Always (all features): device information (manufacturer, model, OS version, build, ML hardware accelerators), app package name and version, performance metrics (latency), API configuration, input/output size, feature version, event types and error codes; used for diagnostics and usage analytics.

dataTypes.type: Device or other IDs / Device or other IDs
dataTypes.when: Always: per-installation identifiers not intended to uniquely identify a user or device. Thin (Play services) features also send a device identifier; GenAI features may send user, device or other identifiers. Used for diagnostics and usage analytics.

ask: Do you send images, text, faces, barcode contents or ML results to your own server? ML Kit processes them on-device, but anything your app transmits must be declared (e.g. Photos, Messages, Files and docs).
Do you use custom models hosted via Firebase Model Deployment (com.google.mlkit:linkfirebase)? Also review the Firebase ML model downloader and Firebase installations disclosures.
Do you use object detection, pose detection, smart reply or translate? These use Firebase Remote Config and Firebase installations; make sure the firebase-config entry is also declared.

sources.title: Prepare for Google Play's data disclosure requirements (ML Kit for Android)

notes: Google states ML Kit encrypts collected data in transit with HTTPS and 'does not transfer this data to third-parties' (shared=false). ML Kit's home page says 'ML Kit's processing happens on-device' and can be used for images and text 'that need to remain on the device'; the disclosure page lists only telemetry, not the images/text being processed. Feature-specific extras (all diagnostics): custom models send model name/version/URI; entity extraction, digital ink, language ID, translate and GenAI send configured or identified languages; barcode auto-zoom sends a session ID, zoom levels and bounding-box coordinates. Mapping of this telemetry to Diagnostics and Device or other IDs is ours; Google uses the phrase 'Device or other identifiers' directly.
